name: dsh-voice-call
description: Voice call plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a floating ball over the shell, realtime speech, and tasks handed to the agent in the conversation window.

summary.en: Call your agent: floating ball, live voice, and the work happens in the chat window.
summary.zh: 给 agent 打电话：悬浮球、实时语音，需要干活时把任务投进对话窗口由 agent 执行。
